items.raw_excerpt: Nearly a month after vast swathes of Queensland were drought declared, pastures are bare, rivers have stopped running, and hay sheds sit empty.
items.summary_en: Nearly a month after vast areas of Queensland were declared in drought, pastures have dried up, rivers have stopped running, and hay sheds sit empty. Farmers are struggling to find feed for their livestock as conditions worsen.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즈랜드 전역에 가뭄이 선포된 지 거의 한 달이 지난 지금, 목장은 메마르고 강물은 멈췄으며 건초 저장고는 비어 있다. 악화되는 기후 조건 속에서 축산 농가들은 가축 먹이를 구하기 위해 고군분투하고 있다.
items.title_en: Queensland graziers pushed to the brink as feed runs dry

items.raw_excerpt: Amid high rents, some tenants are trading floor space for location and lower costs.
items.summary_en: In Singapore, some renters are choosing small storerooms as living spaces because of high rents. These pocket-sized units cost around S$700 per month. They offer a cheap option in a city where location matters more than floor space.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르에서 높은 임대료 때문에 일부 세입자들이 창고방을 주거 공간으로 활용하고 있습니다. 이 초소형 공간은 월 약 700싱가포르달러에 대여할 수 있습니다. 넓은 면적보다 입지 조건이 중요한 도시에서 저렴한 대안으로 주목받고 있습니다.
items.title_en: The S$700 storeroom: Singapore's tiny rental market

items.raw_excerpt: Season 2 of the Oceania Football Confederation Pro-League (OFC Pro-League) will begin in February 2027.
items.summary_en: Season 2 of the Oceania Football Confederation Pro-League will start in February 2027. The league will continue to feature clubs from across the Oceania region.
